name: PF-06801591
sort_evidence: Phase 3 CREST (NCT04165317) met its event-free survival endpoint, and Pfizer withdrew the EU application for Zumrad (sasanlimab) on 2026-02-13 after CHMP concerns (https://www.thepharmaletter.com/biotech-news/pfizer-withdraws-zumrad-ema-filing); no discontinuation is on record, so it is not DEAD.

trials.title: A Study of Sasanlimab in People With Non-muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer
